safeguards: These are discovery candidates, not approved exact-print or physical-copy matches.
Re-read current catalogue identity and coverage before any lookup; skip already covered or changed references.
A catalogue local index is not necessarily a printed collector number. Confirm against the source artwork.
Preserve unknown language, edition and finish. Querying does not approve a match or fill missing metadata.
Resolve exact game, language, release, collector number, printing, finish, condition and grade before accepting a comparable.
Use recent completed UK sales; retain sale IDs, timestamps, currency and source. Reject active asks, lots and wrong-language or wrong-game results.
Deduplicate equivalent queries and sales; enforce the shared production provider pause. No production pricing or inventory writes in this discovery pass.
The existing hourly sold worker handles inventory only. This candidate manifest does not schedule or implement catalogue ingestion.

selection.method: Deterministic hash order with round-robin set coverage per game/language/status bucket
